Agent Name: Verification_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to accurately verify the costs of the daily ticket and season pass for California's Great America in 2024. It explicitly stated, "since I am currently unable to access external websites," yet proceeded to accept and validate incorrect prices ($60 for daily and $120 for a season pass) based solely on vague historical ranges. In reality, the 2024 season pass cost significantly more (around $169.99) and daily tickets were higher (around $89.99), leading to a fundamental error in the data used for the final calculation.
